{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Revolver; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock fits my recent listening, but I would pass this time for something closer to blues.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Citizen Steely Dan: 1972-1980; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The polished songwriting appeals to me, but I would skip a large retrospective on this visit.
